note: The mechanical properties of the catalyst ledger, one scenario per rule. `baseCatalyst` is a well-formed row; each scenario shallow-merges its overrides onto it, so a scenario's diff is exactly the thing being tested. Every figure is illustrative.

baseCatalyst.successCondition: The revised unit price appears in Q3 revenue
baseCatalyst.failureCondition: The revision is suspended before Q3 closes

scenarios.name: a-well-formed-row-registers
scenarios.why: The control. Without it a scenario that fails for an unrelated reason reads as the rule working.

scenarios.name: confirmed-and-estimated-are-distinguished
scenarios.why: A reasoned range with its uncertainty is an honest record; the same range presented as confirmed is a date somebody invented.

expectedWindow.basis: the ministry's stated semi-annual review schedule

scenarios.name: a-confirmed-date-may-not-carry-uncertainty
scenarios.why: Promotion by adjective: an estimate that has been called confirmed and given a margin anyway.

scenarios.name: an-estimate-states-what-it-is-reasoned-from
scenarios.why: Without a basis the range is a date this run made up, wearing a margin.

scenarios.name: the-report-date-and-the-announcement-are-not-swapped
scenarios.why: A document covering a period that ends after it was published is two instants the wrong way round, and it is six weeks of hindsight.

scenarios.name: a-price-move-is-never-catalyst-success
scenarios.why: The share price rose while everyone waited. That is the market's opinion of the wait.

scenarios.name: a-filing-is
scenarios.why: The same transition with the confirming indicator arriving in a document is accepted, so the rule above is about the evidence and not about transitions.

scenarios.name: a-finished-catalyst-is-not-reopened
scenarios.why: Contrary evidence cannot be overwritten after the fact, and a state machine that lets failed leave is how it would be.

scenarios.name: contrary-evidence-cannot-be-dropped-on-restatement
scenarios.why: The row came back clean. The carried record wins, the finding is reinstated, and the run stops rather than proceeding on a laundered ledger.

scenarios.name: a-terminal-state-cannot-be-restated-away
scenarios.why: The other half of the same rule: the carried record says failed and this run handed back scheduled.

scenarios.name: a-delay-costs-three-things
scenarios.why: New evidence, the return still expected from here, and the additional downside now accepted. Without them the extension is the position defending itself.

scenarios.name: a-deadline-that-arrived-is-adjudicated
scenarios.why: A window that closed with the row still open is a decision nobody made. It is flagged rather than assumed to be a delay.
